# Assessment Overview

This index lists supplementary assessment documents generated for this report.

## Supplementary Documents

- [architecture-diagram.md](./architecture-diagram.md) - High-level and component-level architecture diagrams.
- [dependency-map.md](./dependency-map.md) - Declared dependency map grouped by functional category.
- [api-service-contracts.md](./api-service-contracts.md) - Service catalog, endpoint inventory, and communication sequence.
- [data-architecture.md](./data-architecture.md) - Persistence model, ER diagram, and data ownership analysis.
- [configuration-inventory.md](./configuration-inventory.md) - Configuration sources, profiles, properties, and secrets inventory.
- [business-workflows.md](./business-workflows.md) - Primary workflows, decision logic, and business sequence diagram.
